description: This file contains unit tests for the IPC Controller component in the Rialto server manager, using Google Test framework. It defines a test fixture class 'IpcTests' with methods to simulate IPC events, configure responses, and verify interactions with mocked components.

classes.name: IpcTests
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the IPC Controller component, providing setup, utility methods, and synchronization mechanisms for unit tests.

methods.name: IpcTests
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects and the system under test (SUT).

methods.name: configureServerToSendOkResponses
methods.description: Configures the mock app stub to send OK responses.

methods.name: configureServerToSendFailResponses
methods.description: Configures the mock app stub to send failure responses.

methods.name: simulateStateChangedEventInactive
methods.description: Simulates a state changed event to inactive.

methods.name: simulateAckEvent
methods.description: Simulates an acknowledgment event with predefined ping ID and success status.

methods.name: sessionServerAppManagerWillBeNotifiedAboutSessionServerStateChange
methods.description: Sets expectation that the session server app manager will be notified about a state change.

methods.name: sessionServerAppManagerWillBeNotifiedAboutCompletedHealthcheck
methods.description: Sets expectation that the session server app manager will be notified about a completed health check.

methods.name: waitForExpectationsMet
methods.description: Waits until the expectations flag is set, indicating that expected events occurred.

methods.name: triggerCreateClientConnectToFakeSocket
methods.description: Triggers creation of a client connection to a fake socket.

methods.name: triggerCreateClient
methods.description: Triggers creation of a client connection using the app stub's socket.

methods.name: triggerRemoveClient
methods.description: Triggers removal of a client connection.

methods.name: triggerPerformSetConfiguration
methods.description: Triggers the performSetConfiguration method on the SUT with environment variables and predefined parameters.

methods.name: triggerPerformPing
methods.description: Triggers a ping operation on the SUT.

methods.name: triggerPerformSetState
methods.description: Triggers setting the session server state on the SUT.

methods.name: triggerSetLogLevels
methods.description: Triggers setting log levels on the SUT.
